message: 親密に親睦会

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, we're here!」

name: Ria
message: 「So this is Synn's place~~」

name: Misa
message: 「It's closer than I expected...」

name: Synn
message: 「Not as close as yours, Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Is this an apartment building?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. My dad bought it after an acquaintance begged him to, which is fine and all, but...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn is the only tenant here, you know. Won't somebody move in to help him out?」

name: Misa
message: 「I already have a place to live.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, that's too bad...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No sense standing around chatting out here, so don't be shy and come on in.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. These sweets are from everyone for your family.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, you really... shouldn't have bothered.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh, how thoughtful! That's our Misa!」

name: Misa
message: 「I wasn't the one who thought of it, Senpai did. She said we should bring a greeting gift since it's our first time visiting.」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's our Ria-chan for ya!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's from everyone, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much. Thing is, though... my parents aren't around...」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh, y-you don't mean...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's just a solo job transfer. They're alive and well.」

name: Misa
message: 「I hadn't even said anything yet!」

name: Synn
message: 「Mom is head over heels for Dad, so she went along with him. That's why the only ones living here are me and--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yours truly, yours truly.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're just a talking panda, aren't you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whoaaaa~?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wondered where you disappeared to, and sure enough, you went over there.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-What in the world is this mysterious creature...!」

name: Ria
message: 「Whoa, awesome! You keep a chicken in your yard.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A chicken... Hmm, I see. Is this the avian species from the Human World famous for its meat and eggs?」

name: Synn
message: 「His name's Sasami.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, talk about being straight to the point.\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So basically, it's just the two of them--Sasami and Synn--living together in this apartment.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Does that mean you're going to cook Mr. Chicken up into a delicious meal?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ow... That hurts...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey now, Sasami. You shouldn't peck at our guests.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He used to be such a cute little chick back in the day, though~」

name: Ria
message: 「And you still named him Chicken Tender even back then.\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Sasami's really shy around strangers. Now let's see, any eggs today...」

name: Synn
message: 「Darn. None today either, huh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President! Your head is bleeding. It's bleeding!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's just how we show affection, so I'm fine.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-Is that so? Well, if you say so...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~, I wonder when he's finally gonna lay an egg for me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If he did, it'd add one more ingredient to Synn's pantry, too.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, you can't really blame him--he's a rooster, after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Vice President, why are you standing so far away?」

name: Misa
message: 「A-ah, no... it's just...」

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be you're allergic to chickens?」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-that's not it, but...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then come over here. You can't even get inside like that.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-well, that's true, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「If you act that shy, you're gonna make me blush too...\s03」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you blushing?! Besides, I'm not even acting shy!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sigh... After all, it's so cu--」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Sasami and Misa locked eyes.

name: Misa
message: 「Eek.\s08」
Sasami didn't miss the split second Misa flinched.

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaa!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now that's quite an aggressive approach.\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my~~ It seems you're terribly disliked, Vice President.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, is this...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'm shocked. To think Sasami would take to her this much.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A watchdog... no, a mad dog, this one. He's a birdbrain who bares his fangs even at his own master.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yet this is the first time he's ever warmed up this much to someone other than me.」

name: Ria
message: 「Has he really warmed up to her?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sasami's weapon is his beak. Anyone he views as an enemy gets pecked relentlessly with it.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't hear the sound of his deadly weapon. That's proof they're just playing around.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President... she was getting pecked just a moment ago, though.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hah... hah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good job! Looks like you managed to walk three whole steps.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ugh... ughh... This is why I hate animals...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm glad you were able to make friends with Mr. Chicken.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're shining so brightly for thinking that I can't even look at you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Alright! I'll do my best to make friends with him too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, Lolotte! I told you not to touch Sasami!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. If you're not careful, he'll peck your uniform full of holes.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek, that's dangerous!」

name: Misa
message: 「It definitely seems better to stay on his good side...」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, hey, Synn-kun. Is this the gardening I've heard so much about?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Since we have such a nice yard, it felt like a waste not to grow something.」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh, surprising. You really can't judge a book by its cover.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aw, shucks, you're making me blush~」

name: Misa
message: 「That wasn't a compliment!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Where is the gardener gentleman?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahaha! This isn't Lolo-chan's house, there's no way we have one.」

name: Ria
message: 「Amaziiing, it's the Sakura Garden! What can you harvest here?」

name: Synn
message: 「Since I'm growing them in planters, I can't grow anything too big, so it's stuff like asparagus and bell peppers. Shiso leaves, loofah gourds, and things like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Loofahs are vegetables? Not scrub sponges?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn only grows things he can eat! So it's not gardening, it's farming!」

name: Synn
message: 「The skin of a loofah is too tough to eat, sure, but when you simmer it in miso, it's seriously 'delicious!'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so~~ *slurp*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, this guy calls literally anything 'delicious!', so you shouldn't take his word at face value.」

name: Synn
message: 「Plus, you can even extract skin lotion from the stems and stuff. Thanks to that, my skin is super firm and glowing.」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-That sounds rather intriguing...」

name: Synn
message: 「Right now, we can harvest eggplants, bok choy, cauliflower, crown daisies, and things like that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Seasonal autumn veggies... Mmm, sounds yummy.」

name: Misa
message: 「Do you happen to like vegetables, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. Rather than vegetables, I prefer things like hamburger steak or curry rice.」

name: Misa
message: 「My word. I was completely under the impression you were a vegetarian...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why is that?」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, just a hunch.... Hmm... I wonder why?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's gotta be 'cause she's an angel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is a huge prejudice. Besides, I am not an angel!」

name: Misa
message: 「Right, uh-huh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't just agree with him!」

name: Ria
message: 「Did you take care of all of this yourself, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. It's my dinner, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「You're living self-sufficiently. What a surprise.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Disguising it as a home garden while growing poppies to make a killing--expected nothing less.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, the eggs didn't pan out, after all. My only remaining hope is these vegetables.」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's wrong, what's wrong!?」

name: Synn
message: 「They're gone.... My seasonal autumn veggies... have been eaten!!」

name: Misa
message: 「E-Eaten?」

name: Synn
message: 「Look at this. Only the stems of the eggplants are left. And on the cauliflower, just the florets are cleanly gone...」

name: Ria
message: 「You're right... Every single edible part is thoroughly gone...」

name: Synn
message: 「Who on earth would do something like this... Ah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way...」

name: Synn
message: 「That's just cruel... Sasami...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, looks like it's mad.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm the one who wants to be mad! Though, it's also true I haven't been able to feed it enough...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Say no more.」

name: Misa
message: 「Um, chickens don't... eat raw vegetables, I thought...」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaaa!」

name: Synn
message: 「What's eaten is eaten, can't help it now. Still, you can't eat any more, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, everyone. Next, let's go inside the house!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ooh~ I'm excited.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Excuse us!」

name: Misa
message: 「Eh, ah, wait up everyone--!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Pardon the intrusion!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huff, huff... E-Excuse... us...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, right this way!」

name: Ria
message: 「E... Excuse... us.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Senpai. You don't have to come in so timidly.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, oh, I'm sorry. I just couldn't help it...」

name: Synn
message: 「There's nobody here besides me. Please don't hesitate and come right in.」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm just feeling kinda nervous...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why?」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well, that's...」

name: Ria
message: 「There's no way I could say it, it's too embarrassing~~\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What is it this time?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President! What is this cute pink figurine!?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a telephone.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is a telephone!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Quite the retro interior decor, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, it's still alive and kicking.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What!? May I... try using it for a moment?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, though it won't work unless you put money in.」

name: Misa
message: 「An analog phone indeed...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Money, right. Understood.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh... nn... nnh, nnh, nnh. The money won't go in.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, a 500-yen coin won't work. It has to be a 10-yen coin.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-Is that so.... How disappointing.」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have any 10-yen coins?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Because I only have \{this|\s12\s12}...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What...!」
Does that mean everything inside that piggy bank is 500-yen coins!?

name: Synn
message: 「Huff, huff.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa there, easy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ta-da! The grand reveal of the Student Council President's room!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooooh~~!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you think?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-It's surprisingly neat and tidy, isn't it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There's nooothing in here at all~」

name: Misa
message: 「And here I went out of my way to choose my words carefully!」

name: Ria
message: 「E-Excuse me... for intruding~」

name: Ria
message: 「Whoa! So this is... a boy's room...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「No, no, that's not it! I didn't mean it in a weird way, it's just, um, it's my first time in a boy's room, so I got surprised--」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... oops.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Crafting an inorganic, cool room to seduce women--as expected of Synn-sama. Still, Ria-chan belongs to yours truly.」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you even talking about?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Senpai, don't fall for it. He literally just doesn't own any stuff.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka's room just has way too much unnecessary junk. Like plushies and stuff.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm a girl too, you know!? Having one or two plushies is... right, Misa!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ehh!? Y-Yes, of course. Having a few isn't strange at all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm-hmm. So the vice president has plushies~」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-What is it!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's very adorable.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah~」

name: Misa
message: 「You're one to talk, Sakura-kun--you have a cute plushie yourself!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Paqy, cute... huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you he's not a plushie. Paqy's just a talking panda.」

name: Ria
message: 「So he's not a plushie.\s02」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chaaaaan. Comfort meeeee.」

name: Ria
message: 「Bad boy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oka~y.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The President's room... The President's room...」

name: Misa
message: 「Honestly, Lolotte-san. Looking around restlessly like that is unladylike.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah! There is something suspicious in the corner of the room!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey. It's rude to touch things without permission.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I have discovered a magazine!」

name: Misa
message: 「A magazine? C... could that possibly be...! Since it's a boy's room, after all--」

name: Misa
message: 「N-Nooo!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why is that?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-W-W-What do you mean why... Could it be a p-perverted...」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai, please say something to her too~」

name: Ria
message: 「Ba-dump, ba-dump...」

name: Misa
message: 「N-N-No, you mustn't, Senpai... Hey, Nanaka-san!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, I'm going to make some tea, so boil some water~」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm already on it~」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, thank you for your thoughtfulness.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey!! What are you doing while I'm not here, Misa!?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Wha, it wasn't me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Trying to dig up someone's secrets is just too cruel!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's a misunderstanding, a misunderstanding!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, open♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Aaah. I mustn't look, yet I really want to see...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't look!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I don't care anymore!」

name: Misa
message: 「Aah!」

name: Ria
message: 「Aah!\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, man.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Practical Knitting: Winter Collection Special.」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Whaaat? It's just a knitting book... Phew.」

name: Misa
message: 「Aha, ahahahaha...」

name: Synn
message: 「H-How cruel... All of you trampling all over my delicate maiden heart...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Since when are you a maiden?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Knitting... Hohoo, so it's where you use yarn to knit scarves and sweaters to give as gifts to someone you have a crush on, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're not wrong, though Synn's doing it for himself.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He has a crush on himself?! What an intriguing person!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, that's not what I meant.\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「Wool socks are cheap and warm, you know. That's why I borrowed it from the library.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, there's even a cookbook. You're really domestic, Synn-kun. You'd make a great bride.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, come on... Stop saying stuff like that.\s03」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Looks like he doesn't entirely hate the idea.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Vice President. Is this what a dirty--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmmmph! Mghhhhgghh!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's nothing. It's nothing at all, Lolotte-san.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's amazing that you can do handicrafts. You should teach me sometime too~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please teach me too!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way... I'm still nowhere near good enough. I only just started, after all.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Come on, why not?! Let's do some knitting!」

name: Ria
message: 「Look, look, this knit cap looks so warm~~」
Gah, the two of you don't have to cling to me and beg like that!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmph!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, alright, tea's ready for everyone~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Tea~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks, Nanaka-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... You saved me, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't go getting all mushy!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It couldn't be helped!」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank you for the tea. *Sip*...」

name: Misa
message: 「J-Japanese tea again?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry. We don't stock fancy Western drinks here.」

name: Misa
message: 「First the Student Council room and now Sakura-kun's house, I really have to do something about this...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ugh, it's bitter!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, why are you all relaxing?! Were you planning on having a tea party today or something?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, right! That's it, it's supposed to be a get-together!」

name: Ria
message: 「A tea party wouldn't be bad either~ So cozy.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No way! I went through the trouble of bringing delicious food today!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh yeah! We need to put Lolotte's stuff in the freezer!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like it'll fit!」

name: Ria
message: 「So, is it finally time for the big reveal?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, it is. Now then, everyone. Please bring out what you've brought.」
